name: Game Center
author: Austin Larson
description: The pre-game ritual in one panel — session toggles, controllers and instant replay, without six separate bar widgets

barWidget.description: Session toggles, controllers and clip capture in one popout

schema.label: Opens showing
schema.description: Which tab the panel is on when it opens. Also follows whichever tab you last left it on.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units, so it follows your scale. Wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.

schema.label: Session keeps the screen awake
schema.description: Only ever claimed when stay-awake is off to begin with. If you turned it on yourself, or another plugin holds it, Game Center leaves it alone and says so in the panel.

schema.label: Session silences notifications
schema.description: Turns do-not-disturb on for the session and puts it back afterwards — unless you change it yourself mid-session, in which case your change wins.

schema.label: Session turns off night light
schema.description: Restores the exact colour temperature you had, rather than whatever default hyprsunset comes back with.

schema.label: Session sets the performance power profile
schema.description: Hidden on machines that have no performance profile, which is most desktops with a placeholder platform driver.
